blocks.en: Leachables Assessment for Drug Packaging/Delivery Systems: Complete Tutorial Edition

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Leachables 評估的目的、範圍及與 Extractables 評估（USP 1663）的關係
blocks.en: Understand the purpose and scope of leachables assessment and its relationship to extractables assessment (USP 1663)

blocks.zh: 掌握安全閾值體系：TTC、SCT（0.15 µg/day）、QT（5 µg/day）的定義、數值及應用邏輯
blocks.en: Master the safety threshold system: the definitions, values, and application logic of TTC, SCT (0.15 µg/day), and QT (5 µg/day)

blocks.zh: 學會 Analytical Evaluation Threshold (AET) 的完整計算公式，並應用於不同劑型
blocks.en: Learn the complete formula for the Analytical Evaluation Threshold (AET) and apply it to different dosage forms

blocks.zh: 了解 Leachables 研究設計的理想條件與各開發階段的研究需求
blocks.en: Understand the ideal conditions for leachables study design and the study requirements at each development stage

blocks.zh: 掌握 Leachables-Extractables Correlation（L-E 相關性）的建立方法與實際應用
blocks.en: Master how to establish a Leachables-Extractables (L-E) correlation and how it is applied in practice

blocks.zh: 理解 Simulation Studies 的設計邏輯及其作為 L-E 研究替代方案的條件
blocks.en: Understand the design logic of simulation studies and the conditions under which they can replace an L-E study

blocks.zh: 應用 USP 1664 框架制定藥品 Leachables 規格與接受標準
blocks.en: Apply the USP 1664 framework to set leachables specifications and acceptance criteria for drug products

blocks.zh: Section 1 — Purpose, Key Terms & Background | 目的、關鍵術語與背景
blocks.en: Section 1 — Purpose, Key Terms & Background

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — USP 1664 vs 1663 的定位
blocks.en: Core Concept — Positioning USP 1664 vs 1663

blocks.zh: USP 1663 和 1664 是姐妹章節，共同構成 E&L 評估的完整框架：
blocks.en: USP 1663 and 1664 are sister chapters that together form the complete framework for E&L assessment:

blocks.zh: USP 1663：如何研究「包裝材料本身」（實驗室萃取條件下）→ Extractables 評估
blocks.en: USP 1663: how to study the packaging material itself (under laboratory extraction conditions) → extractables assessment

blocks.zh: USP 1664：如何研究「真實藥品中的滲出物」（正常儲存/使用條件下）→ Leachables 評估
blocks.en: USP 1664: how to study leachables in the actual drug product (under normal storage/use conditions) → leachables assessment

blocks.zh: 關鍵連結：1664 的 Leachables 研究通常以 1663 的 Extractables 評估結果作為先驗知識（知道哪些物質可能滲出）。
blocks.en: Key link: a leachables study under 1664 normally uses the results of the 1663 extractables assessment as prior knowledge (what substances might leach).

blocks.zh: USP 1664 的版本更新（Official as of 01-Dec-2024）比 1663 更新，反映了業界對 Leachables 管理科學認知的進展。
blocks.en: USP 1664 (Official as of 01-Dec-2024) is more recent than 1663 and reflects the industry's growing scientific understanding of leachables management.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 三層安全閾值體系
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Three-Tier Safety Threshold System

blocks.zh: USP 1664 定義了三個相關但不同的安全閾值（以 OINDP 為例）：
blocks.en: USP 1664 defines three related but distinct safety thresholds (using OINDP as the example):

blocks.zh: TTC（毒理學關切閾值）：來自 EMA，用於評估基因毒性雜質，1.5 µg/day（風險因子 10⁻⁵）。TTC 是整個閾值體系的理論基礎。
blocks.en: TTC (Threshold of Toxicological Concern): from the EMA, used to assess genotoxic impurities, 1.5 µg/day (risk factor 10⁻⁵). The TTC is the theoretical basis of the whole threshold system.

blocks.zh: SCT（安全關切閾值）= 0.15 µg/day：PQRI 為 OINDP 提出，比 TTC 更嚴格（風險因子 10⁻⁶）。低於 SCT 不需要進行安全評估。
blocks.en: SCT (Safety Concern Threshold) = 0.15 µg/day: proposed by PQRI for OINDP, stricter than the TTC (risk factor 10⁻⁶). Below the SCT, no safety assessment is needed.

blocks.zh: QT（資格確認閾值）= 5 µg/day：低於 QT 且無致癌結構警告的物質，不需要化合物特異性安全評估。
blocks.en: QT (Qualification Threshold) = 5 µg/day: a substance below the QT with no structural alert for carcinogenicity does not need a compound-specific safety assessment.

blocks.zh: 注意：SCT 和 QT 是「評估閾值」，不是「控制限」或「安全限」——超過這些閾值意味著需要進行評估，不代表不安全。
blocks.en: Note: the SCT and QT are "evaluation thresholds", not "control limits" or "safety limits". Exceeding them means an assessment is required, not that the product is unsafe.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 風險矩陣的直觀理解
blocks.en: Analogy — An Intuitive Reading of the Risk Matrix

blocks.zh: Table 1 的風險矩陣把劑型按兩個維度分類：
blocks.en: The risk matrix in Table 1 classifies dosage forms along two dimensions:

blocks.zh: 縱軸：路徑關切度（吸入 > 注射 > 局部）——物質越直接進入人體，風險越高
blocks.en: Vertical axis: concern for the route of administration (inhalation > injection > topical): the more directly a substance enters the body, the higher the risk

blocks.zh: 橫軸：藥品與包裝的相互作用可能性——液體比固體更容易萃取包裝中的物質
blocks.en: Horizontal axis: likelihood of interaction between drug product and packaging: liquids extract substances from packaging more readily than solids

blocks.zh: 最高風險位在左上角（吸入氣霧劑）：藥品直接進入肺部，配方含有機溶劑且長期使用。最低風險在右下角（口服固體）。
blocks.en: The highest-risk position is the upper left corner (inhalation aerosols): the drug goes directly into the lungs, and the formulation contains organic solvents and is used long term. The lowest risk is in the lower right corner (oral solids).

blocks.zh: CDMO 應根據這個矩陣確認客戶藥品的風險等級，進而決定 Leachables 評估的嚴格程度。
blocks.en: A CDMO should use this matrix to confirm the risk level of the client's drug product and then decide how rigorous the leachables assessment needs to be.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 「低風險」不等於零風險
blocks.en: Key Point — "Low Risk" Does Not Mean Zero Risk

blocks.zh: USP 1664 特別指出：即使是低風險劑型（口服片劑、外用粉末），仍存在 Leachables 問題的可能。
blocks.en: USP 1664 specifically points out that even low-risk dosage forms (oral tablets, topical powders) can still have leachables problems.

blocks.zh: 真實案例：標籤黏膠中的化學添加劑可能透過塑膠初級包裝遷移，出現在口服固體藥品的雜質圖譜中，造成 OOS 結果。
blocks.en: Real example: chemical additives in label adhesive can migrate through plastic primary packaging and appear in the impurity profile of an oral solid drug product, causing OOS results.

blocks.zh: 結論：雖然低風險劑型不需要常規 Leachables 研究作為上市申請的一部分，但 CDMO 仍應在風險評估中考慮這種可能性，特別是在調查 OOS 結果時。
blocks.en: Conclusion: although low-risk dosage forms do not require a routine leachables study as part of the marketing application, a CDMO should still consider this possibility in its risk assessment, especially when investigating OOS results.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 某 CDMO 客戶生產一種 pH 6.5 的靜脈注射藥品，裝在 PVC IV bag 中。根據 Table 1，這個藥品的 Leachables 風險等級是什麼？需要進行 Leachables 研究嗎？
blocks.en: A CDMO client manufactures an intravenous drug product at pH 6.5 packaged in a PVC IV bag. According to Table 1, what is the leachables risk level of this product? Is a leachables study required?

blocks.zh: SCT = 0.15 µg/day 和 QT = 5 µg/day 有什麼實際操作上的意義區別？舉一個具體情境說明兩者的應用差異。
blocks.en: What is the practical operational difference between SCT = 0.15 µg/day and QT = 5 µg/day? Give a specific scenario to illustrate how each is applied.

blocks.zh: Section 2 — Concepts: Safety Thresholds & Information Sharing | 安全閾值概念與資訊共享
blocks.en: Section 2 — Concepts: Safety Thresholds & Information Sharing

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — SCT 的邏輯根源
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Logic Behind the SCT

blocks.zh: 為什麼 PQRI 為 OINDP 選擇 0.15 µg/day？這個數字的推導邏輯：
blocks.en: Why did PQRI choose 0.15 µg/day for OINDP? The logic behind the number:

blocks.zh: EMA 的 TTC 方法：1.5 µg/day，使用 10⁻⁵ 的癌症風險因子（即每 100,000 人中增加 1 例）
blocks.en: The EMA's TTC approach: 1.5 µg/day, using a cancer risk factor of 10⁻⁵ (an increase of 1 case per 100,000 people)

blocks.zh: PQRI 認為 OINDP 需要更嚴格的標準，因為：（a）藥物直接進入肺部等敏感器官，（b）可能是終身用藥，（c）Leachables 通常是工業化學品，與藥物活性成分無關
blocks.en: PQRI considered that OINDP needs a stricter standard because: (a) the drug goes directly into sensitive organs such as the lungs, (b) it may be used for life, and (c) leachables are usually industrial chemicals unrelated to the active ingredient

blocks.zh: 因此採用 10⁻⁶ 的風險因子（每 1,000,000 人中增加 1 例），得到 SCT = 1.5 × (10⁻⁶/10⁻⁵) = 0.15 µg/day
blocks.en: A risk factor of 10⁻⁶ was therefore adopted (an increase of 1 case per 1,000,000 people), giving SCT = 1.5 × (10⁻⁶/10⁻⁵) = 0.15 µg/day

blocks.zh: 這個邏輯同樣適用於其他高風險劑型——注射劑的 SCT 值可能也在類似範圍，但需要根據具體劑型的暴露模式計算。
blocks.en: The same logic applies to other high-risk dosage forms: the SCT for injectables may fall in a similar range, but it must be calculated from the exposure pattern of the specific dosage form.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 三層閾值就像交通燈
blocks.en: Analogy — The Three Thresholds Are Like a Traffic Light

blocks.zh: 用交通燈比喻三個閾值對 Leachable 的處理決策：
blocks.en: The traffic light analogy shows the decision made for a leachable at each of the three thresholds:

blocks.zh: 低於 SCT（0.15 µg/day）= 綠燈：物質存在但量極少，不需要鑑定，不需要安全評估。繼續前進。
blocks.en: Below the SCT (0.15 µg/day) = green light: the substance is present but in a very small amount; no identification and no safety assessment needed. Proceed.

blocks.zh: SCT 到 QT 之間（0.15–5 µg/day）= 黃燈：需要進行化學鑑定（確認是什麼物質），但如果沒有結構警告（SAR concerns），不需要進行個別的毒理學評估。謹慎前進。
blocks.en: Between the SCT and QT (0.15–5 µg/day) = yellow light: chemical identification is needed (confirm what the substance is), but if there are no structural alerts (SAR concerns), no individual toxicological assessment is needed. Proceed with caution.

blocks.zh: 高於 QT（>5 µg/day）= 紅燈：需要完整的化學鑑定 + 化合物特異性毒理學評估。停下來評估。
blocks.en: Above the QT (>5 µg/day) = red light: full chemical identification plus a compound-specific toxicological assessment are needed. Stop and assess.

blocks.zh: 記住：這些「燈號」都是評估決策，不是「安全/不安全」的判斷。即使超過 QT，如果毒理學評估顯示安全，仍可接受。
blocks.en: Remember: these "lights" are assessment decisions, not judgments of "safe/unsafe". Even above the QT, a leachable remains acceptable if the toxicological assessment shows it is safe.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 特殊案例化合物（OINDP）
blocks.en: Key Point — Special Case Compounds (OINDP)

blocks.zh: 以下三類物質在 OINDP 中屬於「特殊案例」，因毒性特別高，需要比 SCT 更低的閾值：
blocks.en: The following three classes of substances are "special case" compounds in OINDP; because of their particularly high toxicity, they require thresholds lower than the SCT:

blocks.zh: PAHs/PNAs（多環芳烴）：具有致癌性，廣泛存在於橡膠硫化製品中。閾值基於 GC/MS 的偵測能力設定。
blocks.en: PAHs/PNAs (polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons): carcinogenic and widely present in vulcanized rubber products. The threshold is set based on the detection capability of GC/MS.

blocks.zh: N-亞硝胺：強致癌物，在橡膠固化過程中可能形成，也是近年 NDMA/NDEA 問題的相關物質類別。
blocks.en: N-nitrosamines: potent carcinogens that can form during rubber curing, and a class of substances related to the recent NDMA/NDEA problems.

blocks.zh: 2-巰基苯并噻唑（2-MBT）：橡膠促進劑的降解產物，具有毒性。
blocks.en: 2-Mercaptobenzothiazole (2-MBT): a degradation product of rubber accelerators, and toxic.

blocks.zh: CDMO 評估含橡膠組件（橡膠塞、矽膠管）的包裝系統時，必須特別針對這三類物質建立方法並設定更低的 AET。
blocks.en: When a CDMO evaluates packaging systems containing rubber components (rubber stoppers, silicone tubing), it must develop methods specifically for these three classes and set a lower AET.

blocks.zh: 在 Leachables 研究中發現一個物質的濃度對應 0.8 µg/day 的患者暴露量。根據 OINDP 的 SCT 和 QT 閾值，需要採取哪些評估步驟？
blocks.en: In a leachables study, a substance is found at a concentration corresponding to a patient exposure of 0.8 µg/day. Based on the OINDP SCT and QT thresholds, what assessment steps are needed?

blocks.zh: 為什麼資訊共享（供應商提供材料配方）對 Leachables 評估的效率如此重要？如果供應商拒絕提供配方信息，有什麼替代方案？
blocks.en: Why is information sharing (the supplier providing the material formulation) so important to the efficiency of leachables assessment? If a supplier refuses to provide formulation information, what alternatives are there?

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 供應商稽核的 E&L 要素
blocks.en: Practical Application — E&L Elements in CDMO Supplier Audits

blocks.zh: 在對包裝材料供應商進行稽核時，USP 1664 的資訊共享要求可以轉化為具體稽核項目：
blocks.en: When auditing a packaging material supplier, the information-sharing requirements of USP 1664 can be turned into specific audit items:

blocks.zh: 供應商能提供材料完整配方（包括添加劑種類與比例）嗎？
blocks.en: Can the supplier provide the complete material formulation (including types and proportions of additives)?

blocks.zh: 供應商有進行過 Extractables 研究並提供報告嗎？
blocks.en: Has the supplier performed extractables studies and provided the reports?

blocks.zh: 供應商的製造過程（固化、滅菌、成型）有可能引入特殊案例化合物嗎？
blocks.en: Could the supplier's manufacturing processes (curing, sterilization, molding) introduce special case compounds?

blocks.zh: 材料變更通知（Change Notification）程序是否完善？任何影響 Leachables profile 的變更都必須通知客戶。
blocks.en: Is the Change Notification procedure robust? Any change that affects the leachables profile must be notified to the customer.

blocks.zh: 無法提供這些信息的供應商應被列為「高風險供應商」，需要 CDMO 自行承擔更完整的 Extractables 評估責任。
blocks.en: A supplier that cannot provide this information should be classified as a "high-risk supplier", and the CDMO must take on responsibility for a more complete extractables assessment itself.

blocks.zh: Section 3 — Leachables Study Design | 滲出物研究設計
blocks.en: Section 3 — Leachables Study Design

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 研究設計的四個理想條件
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Four Ideal Conditions for Study Design

blocks.zh: USP 1664 列出的四個理想條件，定義了什麼是「高品質」的 Leachables 研究：
blocks.en: The four ideal conditions listed in USP 1664 define what a "high-quality" leachables study is:

blocks.zh: 真實藥品（非安慰劑）：因為有些 Leachables 只在活性成分存在時才形成（如化學反應產物）
blocks.en: The actual drug product (not a placebo): some leachables form only when the active ingredient is present (e.g., chemical reaction products)

blocks.zh: 商業化最終包裝形式：原型包裝可能與商業化包裝的 Leachables profile 不同
blocks.en: The final commercial packaging configuration: a prototype package may have a different leachables profile from the commercial package

blocks.zh: 相同批次的包材：確保 Extractables 研究和 Leachables 研究使用相同來源，這是建立 L-E 相關性的前提
blocks.en: The same lot of packaging material: this ensures that the extractables study and the leachables study use the same source, which is a prerequisite for establishing an L-E correlation

blocks.zh: 必須包括實時（real-time）評估：加速穩定性（如 40°C/75%RH）可以幫助早期預測，但不能替代 25°C/60%RH 的長期穩定性研究
blocks.en: Must include real-time evaluation: accelerated stability (e.g., 40°C/75%RH) can help with early prediction but cannot replace long-term stability studies at 25°C/60%RH

blocks.zh: 在實際 CDMO 操作中，這四個條件往往很難同時滿足（成本、時間限制），需要與客戶進行科學的風險-效益討論。
blocks.en: In real CDMO operations, these four conditions are often difficult to satisfy simultaneously (cost and time constraints), so a science-based risk-benefit discussion with the client is needed.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — Leachables 研究就像婚後生活觀察
blocks.en: Analogy — A Leachables Study Is Like Observing Married Life

blocks.zh: 繼續 USP 1663 的「化學婚姻」比喻：
blocks.en: Continuing the "chemical marriage" analogy from USP 1663:

blocks.zh: Extractables 研究（USP 1663）：婚前協議——在實驗室受控條件下，強迫了解雙方的「化學個性」。
blocks.en: Extractables study (USP 1663): the prenuptial agreement: under controlled laboratory conditions, you force an understanding of each side's "chemical personality".

blocks.zh: Leachables 研究（USP 1664）：婚後真實生活——觀察兩個「化學個性」在真實相處 2–3 年後，實際發生了哪些化學反應，哪些物質真正滲入了藥品。
blocks.en: Leachables study (USP 1664): real married life: you observe what chemical reactions actually occur after the two "chemical personalities" live together in reality for 2–3 years, and which substances really leach into the drug product.

blocks.zh: 婚前調查再完整，也不能保證婚後完全沒有意外。Extractables 評估提供預測，Leachables 研究提供確認。
blocks.en: However thorough the premarital investigation, it cannot guarantee there will be no surprises after the wedding. The extractables assessment provides a prediction; the leachables study provides confirmation.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 包材批次一致性的重要性
blocks.en: Key Point — Why Packaging Lot Consistency Matters

blocks.zh: 「相同批次包材」的要求容易被忽視，但它是建立有效 L-E 相關性的基礎：
blocks.en: The requirement for the "same lot of packaging material" is easy to overlook, but it is the foundation for establishing a valid L-E correlation:

blocks.zh: 案例：如果 Extractables 研究用的是 Batch A 橡膠塞，但 Leachables 研究用的是 Batch B 橡膠塞，而 Batch B 的配方有微小差異，那麼：
blocks.en: Example: if the extractables study used Lot A rubber stoppers but the leachables study used Lot B rubber stoppers, and the Lot B formulation differs slightly, then:

blocks.zh: Extractables 結果可能無法解釋 Leachables 中出現的某個物質
blocks.en: The extractables results may be unable to explain a substance that appears in the leachables study

blocks.zh: L-E 相關性無法建立
blocks.en: The L-E correlation cannot be established

blocks.zh: 監管機構可能要求重新研究
blocks.en: Regulators may require the studies to be repeated

blocks.zh: 實務建議：在填充生產批次時同步保留若干包材樣品，用於後續的 Extractables 確認研究。
blocks.en: Practical recommendation: when filling production lots, retain some packaging material samples at the same time for later confirmatory extractables studies.

blocks.zh: 一個 NDA 申請的注射藥品在進行 Phase III 臨床試驗。請說明 USP 1664 對此階段的 Leachables 研究有什麼建議，以及 CDMO 應如何協助客戶完成這個要求。
blocks.en: An injectable drug product under an NDA is in Phase III clinical trials. Describe what USP 1664 recommends for leachables studies at this stage and how the CDMO should help the client meet this requirement.

blocks.zh: 為什麼加速穩定性條件（40°C/75%RH）的 Leachables 研究不能完全替代實時研究（25°C/60%RH）？請從化學動力學角度解釋。
blocks.en: Why can a leachables study under accelerated stability conditions (40°C/75%RH) not fully replace a real-time study (25°C/60%RH)? Explain from the standpoint of chemical kinetics.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO Change Control 中的 Leachables 評估
blocks.en: Practical Application — Leachables Assessment in CDMO Change Control

blocks.zh: USP 1664 特別強調：任何導致患者接觸到不同 Leachables profile 的變更，都需要進行 Leachables 研究作為 Change Control 的一部分。
blocks.en: USP 1664 specifically emphasizes that any change that causes patients to be exposed to a different leachables profile requires a leachables study as part of change control.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 日常操作中，以下變更應觸發 Leachables 評估：
blocks.en: In day-to-day CDMO operations, the following changes should trigger a leachables assessment:

blocks.zh: 橡膠塞或瓶子供應商變更（即使規格相同）
blocks.en: A change of rubber stopper or vial supplier (even if the specifications are the same)

blocks.zh: 藥品配方中 pH 或溶劑比例的調整
blocks.en: An adjustment of pH or solvent ratio in the drug product formulation

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌條件的改變（如從乾熱改為濕熱，或調整 F0 值）
blocks.en: A change in terminal sterilization conditions (e.g., from dry heat to moist heat, or an adjustment of the F0 value)

blocks.zh: 填充線設備更換（接觸藥品的材料可能不同）
blocks.en: Replacement of filling line equipment (the drug-contact materials may differ)

blocks.zh: 建立一個「Leachables Impact Assessment」的 SOP，作為 CDMO 變更評估程序的標準步驟之一。
blocks.en: Establish a "Leachables Impact Assessment" SOP as a standard step in the CDMO's change assessment procedure.

blocks.zh: Section 4 — Leachables Characterization & AET Calculation | 滲出物表徵與 AET 計算
blocks.en: Section 4 — Leachables Characterization & AET Calculation

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 — AET 計算完整示例
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation — A Complete AET Calculation Example

blocks.zh:
情境：評估一個吸入溶液（OINDP）的橡膠瓶塞
• 每日使用劑量：4 次吸入/天
• 每瓶標示劑量：200 次吸入
• 每瓶體積：25 mL
• SCT（OINDP）：0.15 µg/day

步驟 1：計算每容器的 AET
AET (µg/容器) = (0.15 µg/day ÷ 4 doses/day) × (200 doses/容器)
             = 0.0375 × 200
             = 7.5 µg/容器

步驟 2：換算為濃度（液態劑型）
AET (µg/mL) = 7.5 µg/容器 ÷ 25 mL/容器
            = 0.3 µg/mL

結論：分析方法必須能夠偵測並定量
      濃度 ≥ 0.3 µg/mL 的任何未知 Leachable
blocks.en:
Scenario: evaluating a rubber stopper for an inhalation solution (OINDP)
• Daily dose: 4 inhalations/day
• Labeled doses per container: 200 inhalations
• Volume per container: 25 mL
• SCT (OINDP): 0.15 µg/day

Step 1: Calculate the AET per container
AET (µg/container) = (0.15 µg/day ÷ 4 doses/day) × (200 doses/container)
             = 0.0375 × 200
             = 7.5 µg/container

Step 2: Convert to a concentration (liquid dosage form)
AET (µg/mL) = 7.5 µg/container ÷ 25 mL/container
            = 0.3 µg/mL

Conclusion: the analytical method must be able to detect and quantify
      any unknown leachable at a concentration ≥ 0.3 µg/mL

blocks.zh: 這個 AET 值直接決定了分析方法的最低偵測限（LOQ）要求，是方法開發的起點。
blocks.en: This AET value directly determines the minimum limit of quantitation (LOQ) required of the analytical method and is the starting point for method development.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 為什麼 Leachables 分析比藥品雜質分析更困難？
blocks.en: Core Concept — Why Is Leachables Analysis Harder Than Drug Impurity Analysis?

blocks.zh: 傳統藥品雜質分析（ICH Q3B）的邏輯：雜質來自藥物合成，化學結構與活性成分相關，可以預測並準備標準品。
blocks.en: The logic of conventional drug impurity analysis (ICH Q3B): impurities arise from drug synthesis, their chemical structures are related to the active ingredient, and they can be predicted and reference standards prepared.

blocks.zh: Leachables 分析的困難：
blocks.en: The difficulties of leachables analysis:

blocks.zh: 化學多樣性極高：從揮發性有機物到金屬元素，涵蓋幾乎所有化學類別
blocks.en: Extremely high chemical diversity: from volatile organics to metallic elements, covering almost every chemical class

blocks.zh: 藥品基質干擾：活性成分、賦形劑的濃度遠高於 Leachables，造成分析干擾
blocks.en: Drug product matrix interference: the concentrations of active ingredients and excipients are far higher than those of the leachables, causing analytical interference

blocks.zh: 無法預先確定所有目標物：需要掃描式（non-targeted）分析方法
blocks.en: Not all targets can be determined in advance: non-targeted (screening) analytical methods are needed

blocks.zh: 標準品可能無法獲得：某些結構複雜的萃取物可能沒有商業標準品
blocks.en: Reference standards may be unavailable: some structurally complex extractables may have no commercial reference standard

blocks.zh: 這些挑戰解釋了為什麼「完整的」Leachables 研究在技術上是困難的，以及為什麼 AET 是一個務實的妥協點。
blocks.en: These challenges explain why a "complete" leachables study is technically difficult and why the AET is a pragmatic compromise.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 方法驗證就像校準秤
blocks.en: Analogy — Method Validation Is Like Calibrating a Scale

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Leachables 分析方法必須完整驗證？
blocks.en: Why must a leachables analytical method be fully validated?

blocks.zh: 想像你在稱量黃金（Leachables 濃度）。如果你的秤（分析方法）沒有經過校準（驗證），你報告的數字就沒有意義——你不知道 0.3 µg/mL 這個讀數是真實的 0.3，還是因為方法不準確而給出的錯誤數字。
blocks.en: Imagine you are weighing gold (the leachables concentration). If your scale (the analytical method) has not been calibrated (validated), the number you report is meaningless: you do not know whether a reading of 0.3 µg/mL is truly 0.3 or a wrong number caused by an inaccurate method.

blocks.zh: USP 1664 要求用於法規申請的方法必須完整驗證，意味著：
blocks.en: USP 1664 requires that methods used for regulatory submissions be fully validated, which means:

blocks.zh: 精確度（Accuracy）：你的秤能正確讀數嗎？
blocks.en: Accuracy: does your scale read correctly?

blocks.zh: 精密度（Precision）：重複測量的結果一致嗎？
blocks.en: Precision: are repeated measurements consistent?

blocks.zh: 特異性（Specificity）：你稱的真的是黃金，不是其他金屬嗎？
blocks.en: Specificity: is what you are weighing really gold and not some other metal?

blocks.zh: 偵測限/定量限（LOD/LOQ）：你能稱出多小的量？必須 ≤ AET。
blocks.en: Detection limit/quantitation limit (LOD/LOQ): how small an amount can you weigh? It must be ≤ the AET.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 樣品前處理的設計邏輯
blocks.en: Key Point — The Design Logic of Sample Preparation

blocks.zh: 樣品前處理（Sample Preparation）的設計原則：創造一個讓分析技術能「看見」Leachables 的樣品形態，同時盡量去除藥品基質的干擾。
blocks.en: Design principle of sample preparation: create a sample form in which the analytical technique can "see" the leachables while removing as much of the drug product matrix interference as possible.

blocks.zh: 實際操作提示：
blocks.en: Practical tips:

blocks.zh: 加速穩定性樣品（40°C/75%RH，3個月）可以用於方法開發，因為它含有更高濃度的 Leachables，更容易建立方法並評估回收率
blocks.en: Accelerated stability samples (40°C/75%RH, 3 months) can be used for method development because they contain higher concentrations of leachables, making it easier to establish the method and evaluate recovery

blocks.zh: 對含有機溶劑的藥品（如 MDI），樣品前處理必須保留揮發性組分，否則會低估揮發性 Leachables
blocks.en: For drug products containing organic solvents (e.g., MDI), sample preparation must preserve the volatile components; otherwise volatile leachables will be underestimated

blocks.zh: 使用 spike recovery（加標回收率）評估樣品前處理方法，確保 Leachables 不在處理過程中損失
blocks.en: Use spike recovery to evaluate the sample preparation method and ensure the leachables are not lost during processing

blocks.zh: 計算：某注射藥品（aqueous, pH 6.5），每日最多注射 2 次，每瓶體積 10 mL，標示 10 次注射。使用 SCT = 0.15 µg/day，計算此藥品的 AET（µg/mL）。
blocks.en: Calculation: an injectable drug product (aqueous, pH 6.5) is injected at most 2 times per day; each vial has a volume of 10 mL and is labeled for 10 injections. Using SCT = 0.15 µg/day, calculate the AET (µg/mL) for this drug product.

blocks.zh: 驗證一個 Leachables 定量方法時，你選擇的空白基質（blank matrix）必須具備什麼特性？為什麼不能直接用超純水作為空白基質？
blocks.en: When validating a leachables quantitation method, what properties must the blank matrix you choose have? Why can ultrapure water not be used directly as the blank matrix?

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO Leachables 方法開發策略
blocks.en: Practical Application — Leachables Method Development Strategy for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 在承接客戶委託的 Leachables 研究時，CDMO 實驗室應遵循以下策略：
blocks.en: When undertaking a leachables study commissioned by a client, the CDMO laboratory should follow this strategy:

blocks.zh: 確定 AET：根據客戶藥品的劑型、每日劑量和容器體積計算
blocks.en: Determine the AET: calculate it from the client's drug product dosage form, daily dose, and container volume

blocks.zh: 獲取 Extractables 數據：向客戶或包材供應商索取已有的 Extractables 報告，作為目標化合物清單的基礎
blocks.en: Obtain extractables data: request existing extractables reports from the client or packaging material supplier as the basis for the target compound list

blocks.zh: 選擇分析平台：GC/MS（揮發性） + LC/MS（非揮發性） + ICP/MS（元素）是標準組合
blocks.en: Select the analytical platforms: GC/MS (volatiles) + LC/MS (non-volatiles) + ICP/MS (elements) is the standard combination

blocks.zh: 開發樣品前處理方法：用加標回收率評估，確保回收率在 70%–130% 範圍內
blocks.en: Develop the sample preparation method: evaluate it with spike recovery, ensuring recovery is within 70%–130%

blocks.zh: 執行全面驗證：準確度、精密度、LOQ（≤ AET）、特異性、耐受性
blocks.en: Perform full validation: accuracy, precision, LOQ (≤ AET), specificity, robustness

blocks.zh: 執行方法系統適用性：每次使用分析方法前確認系統正常運作
blocks.en: Perform method system suitability: confirm the system is working properly before each use of the analytical method

blocks.zh: Section 5 — L-E Correlation, Specifications & Simulation Studies | L-E 相關性、規格制定與模擬研究
blocks.en: Section 5 — L-E Correlation, Specifications & Simulation Studies

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — L-E 相關性的實際價值
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Practical Value of an L-E Correlation

blocks.zh: 建立 L-E 相關性的最重要實用價值：用包材放行測試（Extractables 測試）替代昂貴的藥品穩定性 Leachables 測試。
blocks.en: The most important practical value of establishing an L-E correlation: using packaging material release testing (extractables testing) in place of costly drug product stability leachables testing.

blocks.zh: 邏輯：如果我們能證明「每當包材批次的 Extractables 在控制水準，藥品中的 Leachables 也必然在安全水準」，那麼我們就不需要每批藥品都做完整的 Leachables 穩定性研究——只需要在包材放行時測試 Extractables 即可。
blocks.en: The logic: if we can show that "whenever a packaging material lot's extractables are at a controlled level, the leachables in the drug product are necessarily at a safe level", then we do not need to run a full leachables stability study on every drug product lot; we only need to test extractables at packaging material release.

blocks.zh: 這對高風險 CDMO 客戶（如吸入劑、注射劑）的 QC 策略具有重大的成本和時間影響。沒有 L-E 相關性，每批藥品都需要長達 2 年的穩定性追蹤。
blocks.en: This has a major cost and time impact on the QC strategy for high-risk CDMO clients (e.g., inhalation products, injectables). Without an L-E correlation, every drug product lot needs stability follow-up of up to 2 years.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 — 定量 L-E 相關性的驗證邏輯
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation — Verification Logic for a Quantitative L-E Correlation

blocks.zh:
BHT 的 L-E 相關性驗證（USP 1664 範例）：

已知條件：
• 藥品中 BHT 濃度（最高穩定性時間點）：5 µg/mL
• 藥品每容器體積：50 mL
• 同批次包材 Extractables 研究中 BHT：300 µg/組件
• 每容器使用組件數：1個

計算：
• BHT 作為 Leachable 的總量：5 × 50 = 250 µg
• BHT 作為 Extractable 的總量：300 µg

驗證：250 µg (leached) ≤ 300 µg (extracted) ✓
→ 定量相關性成立！

意義：從包材萃取到的 BHT 多於藥品中實際出現的量
（50 µg 的差額可能是未滲出或降解消失）
→ Extractables 是 Leachables 的保守估計 ✓
blocks.en:
L-E correlation verification for BHT (USP 1664 example):

Known conditions:
• BHT concentration in the drug product (latest stability time point): 5 µg/mL
• Drug product volume per container: 50 mL
• BHT in the extractables study of the same packaging lot: 300 µg/component
• Components used per container: 1

Calculation:
• Total BHT as a leachable: 5 × 50 = 250 µg
• Total BHT as an extractable: 300 µg

Verification: 250 µg (leached) ≤ 300 µg (extracted) ✓
→ The quantitative correlation holds!

Meaning: more BHT was extracted from the packaging material than actually appeared in the drug product
(the 50 µg difference may be BHT that did not leach or that was lost through degradation)
→ Extractables are a conservative estimate of leachables ✓

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — Simulation Study 就像食品模擬試驗
blocks.en: Analogy — A Simulation Study Is Like Food Simulant Testing

blocks.zh: Simulation Study 的概念在食品包裝法規（如 21 CFR 177）中早就存在：
blocks.en: The concept of a simulation study has long existed in food packaging regulations (e.g., 21 CFR 177):

blocks.zh: 食品法規允許用「食品模擬液」（如水、乙酸、乙醇、橄欖油）替代真實食品進行包材相容性測試——因為直接用真實食品（如一桶義大利麵醬）做測試既昂貴又複雜。
blocks.en: Food regulations allow "food simulants" (e.g., water, acetic acid, ethanol, olive oil) to be used in place of real food for packaging compatibility testing, because testing with real food (such as a barrel of pasta sauce) directly is both expensive and complicated.

blocks.zh: USP 1664 的 Simulation Study 邏輯相同：用化學特性與藥品配方相似的模擬溶劑（simulating solvent）替代真實藥品，進行 Extractables 研究，再將結果用於預測 Leachables。
blocks.en: The logic of a USP 1664 simulation study is the same: a simulating solvent whose chemical characteristics are similar to the drug product formulation replaces the actual drug product in an extractables study, and the results are then used to predict leachables.

blocks.zh: 關鍵要求：模擬溶劑的「萃取能力」必須≥真實藥品，確保模擬研究是保守估計（過估）而非低估。
blocks.en: Key requirement: the "extraction capability" of the simulating solvent must be ≥ that of the actual drug product, ensuring that the simulation study is a conservative estimate (overestimate) rather than an underestimate.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — Leachables 規格的特殊性
blocks.en: Key Point — The Special Nature of Leachables Specifications

blocks.zh: Leachables 規格與普通藥品規格（如含量、雜質）有一個重要區別：
blocks.en: Leachables specifications differ from ordinary drug product specifications (e.g., assay, impurities) in one important way:

blocks.zh: Leachables 在整個貨架期都在累積，因此規格必須適用於貨架期的所有時間點，包括上市時（release）和貨架期末（end of shelf-life）。
blocks.en: Leachables accumulate throughout the shelf life, so the specification must apply at all time points of the shelf life, including release and end of shelf-life.

blocks.zh: 這意味著：
blocks.en: This means:

blocks.zh: 上市放行的 Leachables 濃度通常低於貨架期末——因此規格必須以「貨架期末」的最高預期濃度為基準設定
blocks.en: Leachables concentrations at release are usually lower than at end of shelf-life, so the specification must be set based on the highest expected concentration at end of shelf-life

blocks.zh: 在制定接受標準時，需要考慮穩定性趨勢（是否線性累積？是否在某個時間點趨於平衡？）
blocks.en: When setting acceptance criteria, the stability trend must be considered (does it accumulate linearly? does it level off at some time point?)

blocks.zh: 如果藥品穩定性研究在 18 個月時發現某 Leachable 的濃度超過了 Extractables 研究估計的最大可能累積量，這意味著什麼？可能的原因有哪些？應如何處理？
blocks.en: If, in the drug product stability study at 18 months, the concentration of a leachable exceeds the maximum possible accumulation estimated from the extractables study, what does this mean? What are the possible causes? How should it be handled?

blocks.zh: 某藥品 Simulation Study 顯示模擬萃取物中某物質的濃度為 2 µg/mL，而 AET 為 0.5 µg/mL。是否可以直接用 Simulation Study 的結果宣稱「Leachables 符合要求」？為什麼？
blocks.en: A drug product simulation study shows a concentration of 2 µg/mL for a substance in the simulated extract, while the AET is 0.5 µg/mL. Can the simulation study result be used directly to claim that "leachables meet the requirements"? Why or why not?

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 建立 L-E 相關性資料庫
blocks.en: Practical Application — Building an L-E Correlation Database at a CDMO

blocks.zh: 對於承接多個類似藥品（如同一包材供應商的注射劑 fill-finish 業務）的 CDMO，建立系統性的 L-E 相關性資料庫具有巨大的長期價值：
blocks.en: For a CDMO that handles many similar drug products (e.g., injectable fill-finish work using packaging from the same supplier), building a systematic L-E correlation database has great long-term value:

blocks.zh: 前期投資：對標準包材組合（如特定供應商的橡膠塞 + 玻璃瓶）建立完整的 Extractables 數據庫
blocks.en: Upfront investment: build a complete extractables database for standard packaging material combinations (e.g., a specific supplier's rubber stopper + glass vial)

blocks.zh: 長期回報：新客戶使用相同包材時，可以調用歷史數據，大幅縮短 Extractables 評估的時間和成本
blocks.en: Long-term return: when new clients use the same packaging materials, historical data can be reused, greatly shortening the time and cost of extractables assessment

blocks.zh: L-E 相關性應用：一旦建立了特定包材在特定配方類型下的 L-E 相關性，可以用包材 Extractables 放行規格替代昂貴的藥品穩定性 Leachables 測試
blocks.en: Applying the L-E correlation: once an L-E correlation is established for a specific packaging material in a specific type of formulation, a packaging material extractables release specification can replace costly drug product stability leachables testing

blocks.zh: 監管槓桿：完善的 L-E 相關性數據可以在 NDA/ANDA 審查中大幅提升包裝章節的審查信心
blocks.en: Regulatory leverage: robust L-E correlation data can substantially increase reviewer confidence in the packaging section during NDA/ANDA review

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: USP 1664 的定位：1663 的姐妹章節，從 Extractables（包材研究）進入 Leachables（藥品研究），是 E&L 評估框架的第二步。
blocks.en: Positioning of USP 1664: the sister chapter of 1663, moving from extractables (packaging material studies) to leachables (drug product studies); the second step of the E&L assessment framework.

blocks.zh: 三層安全閾值：TTC（1.5 µg/day）→ SCT（0.15 µg/day，OINDP）→ QT（5 µg/day，OINDP）；均為評估閾值，非控制限。
blocks.en: Three-tier safety thresholds: TTC (1.5 µg/day) → SCT (0.15 µg/day, OINDP) → QT (5 µg/day, OINDP); all are evaluation thresholds, not control limits.

blocks.zh: AET 計算：SCT ÷ doses/day × labeled doses/container，再除以容器體積得到 µg/mL 或 µg/g。AET 決定分析方法的最低 LOQ 要求。
blocks.en: AET calculation: SCT ÷ doses/day × labeled doses/container, then divided by the container volume to give µg/mL or µg/g. The AET determines the minimum LOQ required of the analytical method.

blocks.zh: 研究設計四原則：真實藥品、商業化包裝、相同批次包材、必須包括實時評估。
blocks.en: Four principles of study design: actual drug product, commercial packaging, same lot of packaging material, and real-time evaluation included.

blocks.zh: L-E 相關性的價值：成立後可以用包材 Extractables 放行測試替代藥品 Leachables 穩定性測試，是 CDMO 降低 QC 成本的重要工具。
blocks.en: Value of an L-E correlation: once established, packaging material extractables release testing can replace drug product leachables stability testing, an important tool for CDMOs to reduce QC cost.

blocks.zh: Simulation Study：當直接 Leachables 分析技術上不可行時，用模擬溶劑進行 Extractables 研究代替，條件是模擬溶劑的萃取能力必須 ≥ 真實藥品。
blocks.en: Simulation study: when direct leachables analysis is technically infeasible, an extractables study with a simulating solvent is used instead, provided the extraction capability of the simulating solvent is ≥ that of the actual drug product.

blocks.zh: 規格制定：基於至少三批次數據，兼顧科學（L-E 相關性）、生產能力和安全性；規格必須適用於整個貨架期（包括 end of shelf-life）。
blocks.en: Specification setting: based on data from at least three lots, balancing science (L-E correlation), manufacturing capability, and safety; the specification must apply over the entire shelf life (including end of shelf-life).

blocks.zh: 特殊案例化合物（OINDP）：PAHs、N-亞硝胺、2-MBT 需要更低的閾值，CDMO 評估橡膠組件時必須特別關注。
blocks.en: Special case compounds (OINDP): PAHs, N-nitrosamines, and 2-MBT require lower thresholds, and CDMOs must pay particular attention to them when evaluating rubber components.
